compose_extrinsic_R_T: compose extrinsic camera matrix from rotation and translation tensors
decompose_extrinsic_R_T: decompose extrinsic camera matrix into rotation and translation components
build_camera_standard: build combined camera matrix from extrinsic RT and intrinsic parameters
center_looking_at_camera_pose: generate camera extrinsics from position with look-at and up vectors
get_surrounding_views: generate surrounding camera poses arranged in a circle at given radius and elevation
